chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: Tired of one-nighters and leaving the World's Greatest Jazz Band
summary: He is fed up with travel and one-nighters, and left the World's Greatest Jazz Band partly for his legs and the grind of tours.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Was that also because you didn't want to travel then and wanted to stay in --

Well, I couldn't travel at that time -- being sick. No traveling. I was tired traveling in a way really. I had been fed up with traveling for a long while. I don't mind working somewhere for a week or two weeks or maybe a month, but one-nighter things -- that's out.
You know. Unless it's right around town -- close around in your area within a hundred miles or maybe 150 - 200 limit. Somewhere you can get to right quick and right back, you know.
So one of the reasons why you left the world's greatest jazz band was --
Yeah, that's right. And I was having trouble with my legs and things.
But that outfit is still doing the kind of tours that you don't really get much anymore unless you're in a big band or something like that.
We did a whole lot of one-nighters and that got me down.
